title: Perfect size
text: Perfect size. I got these baskets to hold our multiple remote controls for tv, dvd, sound bar, etc. I had conventional remote holders, but they were ugly. The baskets are the perfect size for my needs and are aesthetically pleasing.

product_metadata.title: Hoffmaster BSK3000 Seagrass Basket with Handles, 4.25" Height, 6.25" Width, 12" Length, Dark Brown
features: Keeps guest towels dry and organized
Natural Brown color complements any décor!
Top of the basket is 6-1/4 inches wide and tapers at the bottom. The basket is 12 inches long and 4-1/4 inches tall
Fits folded guest towels measuring 4-1/2 inches by 8-1/2 inches
description: The Hoffmaster Seagrass Basket with Wooden Handles is designed to keep guest towels dry and organized on your countertops. Our beautiful natural brown basket will compliment any decor. Designed to fit our disposable Linen-Like or FashnPoint folded guest towels that measure 4-1/2 inches by 8-1/2 inches when folded (12 inches by 17 inches when unfolded). Finer hotels and restaurants have used our Seagrass Basket to provide their guests with an exception experience. Disposable guest towels help to prevent the spread of germs and provide a superior alternative to cloth towels. Our basket measures 12 inches long by 6-1/4 inches wide and 4-1/4 inches tall. The width at the top is wider than the bottom.
